description: This file defines the PermissionMapper class with static methods for converting permission data between different formats, including mapping database permissions to domain models, converting to and from permission strings, and generating action maps based on permissions.

classes.name: PermissionMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for permission data transformations and validation.

methods.name: toDomain
methods.description: Converts database permission objects into domain-specific TeamPermissions objects.

methods.name: toPermissionString
methods.description: Converts a Permission object into a string format 'resource.action'.

methods.name: fromPermissionString
methods.description: Parses a permission string into a Permission object, validating format.

methods.name: toActionMap
methods.description: Generates a map of resource actions to booleans indicating permissions based on permission strings.

methods.name: isActionAvailableForResource
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is available for a given resource in the permission registry.
